I can't do that as asked, and I want to flag why rather than guess.

**Locations have no approval state in this project.** Per the input contract, a location sheet's front-matter is only `id, name, mood?, lighting?, palette[], variants[]`. There's no `status` field and no `approved_*` field — that whole approve/lock lifecycle exists only on **characters** (`status: draft|candidates|approved|locked`, `approved_portrait`). So there's nothing on the 26 location sheets I could set to "approved."

Also, "assets" usually means the generated background images. I only edit the **input** source files — I never run the image-generation pipeline, so I can't approve or bless rendered image assets from here.

So before I propose anything, which did you mean?

Right — that's outside what I do. Approving the generated location background images is an **image-pipeline** step: I only author the *input* source files (character/location/scene text and the Fountain screenplay) and never run the generation pipeline, so I can't render, review, or bless those image assets.

You'll want to do that with your generation tooling (e.g. the `vngen` side / whatever renders and stores approvals for backgrounds), not here.

What I *can* help with, if useful:
- **Audit the 26 location sheets** — make sure each has a solid description, `mood`/`lighting`, a `palette`, and any `variants` the scene headings mine (read-only).
- **Fix the 8 open warnings** (several scenes show as `unreachable` — the whole `wr_*` Wren route plus `ud_binding/ud_conquest/ud_epilogue/ud_final_boss` aren't reached from the entry scene). That's a real cross-file invariant worth addressing.

Want me to look into either of those?
